title: hybanthus supinus
intro: Hybanthus supinus, commonly known as the poison leaf or poison-ivy, is a plant species in the family Gentianaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Hybanthus supinus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
